note: Every production file that reaches ctx.subprocess, with its call count and class (P3-10 R5; checked by scripts/first100/verify-spawn-call-sites.mjs). A call site counts when a non-comment line of packages/<group>/<pkg>/src/ or apps/<app>/src/ calls subprocess.spawn( or subprocess.spawnTerminal(, or reads the service with get('subprocess'); the seam's own packages and the generated API catalog are not callers. A caller that stores the service under another name is not counted, so whoever adds one adds its row here. Classes: limited (the call carries the bound world's ceilings), deferred (it will, in the work-order phase named by until), exempt (it belongs to no world), opt-in-mount (a provider a deployment mounts itself, outside the dsh file sandbox and the ceilings once mounted), spawns-nothing (it reads the service but starts no process through it).
